Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find

Class ModernFindStrategyRegistry

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.basic.find.ModernFindStrategyRegistry
@Component public class ModernFindStrategyRegistry extends Object
Registry for different find strategies available in the system.

This component acts as a central registry that maps FindStrategy types to their corresponding implementation functions. It provides a unified way to access various find strategies such as image matching, text finding, color detection, motion analysis, and more. The registry pattern allows for easy extension with custom find strategies.

This is version 2 of the registry, updated to work with the new ActionConfig hierarchy and FindStrategy enum instead of ActionConfig.Find.

Since:
2.0

  • Method Details

    • setCustomFind

      public void setCustomFind(BiConsumer<ActionResult,List<ObjectCollection>> customFind)
      Registers a custom find function that can be used with FindStrategy.CUSTOM.

      This method allows users to extend the find functionality by providing their own implementation. The custom function will be invoked when the find options specify FindStrategy.CUSTOM as the find strategy.

      Parameters:
      customFind - The custom find function to register. Must accept an ActionResult (which will be populated with matches) and a list of ObjectCollections to search within. Must not be null.

    • get

      public BiConsumer<ActionResult,List<ObjectCollection>> get(BaseFindOptions findOptions)
      Retrieves the appropriate find function based on the find options.

      This method extracts the find strategy from the provided options and returns the corresponding registered function. For CUSTOM strategies, it returns the custom function if one has been registered.

      Parameters:
      findOptions - The options specifying which find strategy to use
      Returns:
      The find function corresponding to the specified strategy, or null if no function is registered for the specified find type.

    • get

      public BiConsumer<ActionResult,List<ObjectCollection>> get(FindStrategy strategy)
      Retrieves the appropriate find function based on the find strategy.

      This is a convenience method that directly accepts a FindStrategy enum value.

      Parameters:
      strategy - The find strategy to use
      Returns:
      The find function corresponding to the specified strategy, or null if no function is registered for the specified strategy.

    • runFindStrategy

      public void runFindStrategy(FindStrategy strategy, ActionResult matches, ObjectCollection... objectCollections)
      Executes the find strategy with the given parameters.

      This method looks up and executes the appropriate find function based on the provided strategy. If no function is registered for the strategy, this method returns without performing any action.

      Parameters:
      strategy - The find strategy to execute
      matches - The action result to populate with matches
      objectCollections - The collections of objects to search for
